name: Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund
oneLiner: USCC is Bitwise's crypto carry fund share, earning basis and staking income with market-day USD or USDC redemption through Superstate.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USCC is a direct NAV-accreting fund share issued by a Delaware statutory-trust series. Its cash-and-carry strategy combines crypto spot and staking positions with short derivatives and Treasury exposure. This supports the synthetic-delta-neutral archetype; navToken independently establishes cash-equivalent listing class under the listing-policy precedence rules, without classifying the fund as a Treasury-only book.

collateral: Managed crypto cash-and-carry portfolio including BTC, ETH, staked SOL and XRP spot exposure, short CME/Coinbase futures, USD, USDC and USTB fund shares. The unaudited October 13, 2026 holdings disclose signed futures notionals and a positive USDC balance; they do not supply a long-only reserve allocation or independent hedge reconciliation.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting fund share, not a $1 peg. NAV is assets less liabilities divided by shares, marked each business day using crypto and futures closes, staking conversion rates and dealer OTC marks. Qualified Purchasers with allowlisted wallets request USD or USDC redemption through Superstate. Ordinary market-day requests before 5pm ET pay T+1 and later requests T+2; the redemption program may be modified or terminated.

proofOfReserves.provider: Superstate daily fund NAV and unaudited holdings; Ernst & Young LLP is the named fund auditor, but no current signed financial report or full token/book-entry liability reconciliation was publicly retrieved.

jurisdiction.license: Delaware Statutory Trust series; fund access restricted to Qualified Purchasers in supported jurisdictions

notices.title: Conditional market-day redemption
notices.message: USCC is a restricted private-fund share with variable NAV. Ordinary USD or USDC payouts follow market-day T+1/T+2 processing, but the issuer's factsheet permits modifying or terminating the redemption program. The $100,000 minimum is for initial investment, not a published redemption minimum.
